conditions.note: one world and one tab per run; a benchmark must not share the GPU with builds, renders or other agents

isolation: exclusive process lock, one browser context, one page

readiness.definition: diorama-ready after preload, shader warm-up, first interactive animation frame and loader dismissal

gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Pro, Unspecified Version)

animationGpu.method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 around the animation frame in the render loop
animationGpu.attribution: requires >=3 alternating repetitions; compare run medians, not single samples

cpu.scope: Chromium renderer main thread; not total system CPU

captureFrameGpu.method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 around an explicit composer frame
